profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-headquartered public company, traded under the ticker HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar solutions. On its own site the company says its lidar sensors support ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence, and that it works with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide, delivering mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries. It is a for-profit company and files with the SEC under CIK 0001861737.

The company presents lidar as the sensing layer for intelligent vehicles, providing high-resolution 3D perception that enables features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot), along with advanced semi-autonomous driving. It also says it supplies sensors meeting the standards for L4+ autonomous driving, aimed at robotaxis, robobuses, trucking, and industrial applications.

The record held on the company lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers, so the available material rests on the company's own description of its lidar business and its public-company details.
